price_scope: Public goods API base price; tax, shipping and checkout price to be confirmed

evaluated_mini.output_spec: Manufacturer-stated 5V / 2.5A continuous; validate actual system at 2A, including low battery
evaluated_mini.batteries: 3 matched 10440 cells supplied by manufacturer, 350mAh each, parallel 1S system, nominal total 1050mAh
evaluated_mini.verification_scope: Product, public price, schematic and linked datasheets reviewed; no hardware test
evaluated_mini.pin_limitations: Signal high voltages and actual fitted pullups must be checked; do not connect signals directly to ESP32 before interface verification
evaluated_mini.charge_limitations: Linked ETA6953 default charge current is 2040mA. Supplied 1050mAh group charge rating and reset-safe current control are unconfirmed. Linked examples searched without finding clear ETA6953 current setup; do not treat absence as proof of hardware default on actual board.

sources.eta1188_package_note: Linked ETA1188F3W document shows 20 pins; schematic ETA1188FC shows 24 pins. Do not use linked pinout for manufacturing.
